play.action: four-frame one-shot pressure, immediately readable over #10131c. Frame 1 brings a huge iron-red hand, slab, and two heavy chains from the top; frames 2 and 3 press them lower; frame 4 holds them across at least 70% width and 35% height. Fill every major form with opaque medium iron red #7A2834, add broad #B9363F planes, and outline every lower edge with a fully opaque hot crimson-orange #FF5A3C rim 32-56 pixels thick. Pure black and near-black are forbidden anywhere in the effect. No faint silhouette, hairline rim, tiny isolated links, or translucent-only red. Keep the lower 30% empty.

style: massive high-contrast iron-red pressure effect matching the accepted base image; opaque medium-red #7A2834 and #B9363F forms with a thick fully opaque #FF5A3C rim, absolutely no black or near-black fill, crisp hard edges, no pixel art, no palette reduction
